description: This file appears to be a Bitbake recipe (`*.inc`) used to build and configure a cross-compiler toolchain based on GCC for a specific target architecture. It contains metadata, dependencies, configuration flags, environment variable exports, build steps, installation instructions, and other build-related logic for building a cross-arch GNU C compiler.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures environment variables and runs the configuration step for cross-compiler build.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Builds the cross-compiler components including libgcc and related headers.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the built cross-compiler, cleans up unnecessary files, creates symlinks, and sets permissions.
